attempts.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 with the specified ed25519 public key in ~/.ssh/authorized_keys (mode 600, correct ownership), locked opsadmin's password, and fixed /etc/ssh/sshd_config so PasswordAuthentication no (and ChallengeResponseAuthentication/KbdInteractiveAuthentication no, PubkeyAuthentication yes) takes effect as the first-matching directive for all users, enforcing key-based SSH authentication. Verified via sshd -T and a live SSH attempt (rejected with publickey-only offer, no password prompt). Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id/service state, issued `shutdown -r now` in the background so the ack returned before disconnection, polled until node1 was reachable again, confirmed a new boot_id (proving an actual restart), and re-verified sshd active, authorized_keys intact, opsadmin password still locked, and key-only auth still enforced post-restart.
